name: element-11-2026
title: Element 11
directions:
From Salt Lake City, Utah (180 Miles ~3 hours)
• Travel north on I15 about 75 miles to the I-84 junction near Tremonton. 
• Keep left and follow I-84 west to UT-30 at Exit 5 (two miles west of Snowville, fill up in Snowville). 
• About 15 miles after you exit I-84 towards Park Valley, the road that continues straight ahead turns into Hwy 42. 
• Stay on Hwy 30 (turn left) where you see the signs towards Park Valley. 
• Follow UT-30 west for 42 miles and turn left at mile marker 33 on to Immigrant Trail Rd. (GPS coordinates 41.610087,-113.565560).
• Travel east on Immigrant Trail Rd about 8 miles and turn right on Red Dome Road (may not be marked). 
• Follow Red Dome Road south about 4.5 miles to reach Stargazer Ranch.

From Oasis, NV (80 miles ~1.5 hours)
•  From Oasis, NV off I-80 (30 miles west of Wendover) Travel north on Hwy 233. 
• Travel about 70 miles and turn right at mile marker 33 on to Immigrant Trail Rd. (GPS coordinates 41.610087,-113.565560).
• Travel east on Immigrant Trail Rd about 8 miles and turn right on Red Dome Road (may not be marked). 
• Follow Red Dome Road south about 4.5 miles to reach Stargazer Ranch. Welcome home!

name: frostburn-2026
title: Frostburn
directions:
Start on WV 7 East (From Morgantown)

Turn left	        - onto Depot Way/East Street (Continue 0.2 miles)
Continue	- onto Herring Way (1.7 miles)
Turn Left		- onto Sunny Hill Road (no street sign, follow Frostburn sign) (1.2 miles)
Slight Right	- onto Nuce Road (0.2 miles)
Turn Left		- onto Green Run Long Hollow Road (0.25 miles)
Turn Right	- onto Huggins Dr  (site entrance, no street sign) (0.2 miles)
Turn Right 	- onto Production Rd (no street sign) (0.25 miles)
Continue	- to Gate Tent and check in. (0.3 miles)

Welcome Home! (0.1 miles)
